reply_text: @Bettina Kroll: The official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was November 3, 2025. Moss's 2025-11-02 digest gives the same date. Your own cutover recap (2025-12-08) says you kept running the account day to day until November 21, and Kwame fully took over on November 22. If the tracker needs the day-to-day change, use November 22; for the official change, use November 3.
